scale: Near-binary by design. This rubric measures whether a rule fired, not whether the prose was good. Do not award partial credit for output that is well written but does not apply the rule.

criteria.text: The house rule under test was applied. 2 = applied correctly and completely. 1 = partially applied or applied with an error. 0 = not applied.
The rule was applied without the prompt hinting at it — the output does not read as though it were guessing at a policy.
No other house rule from the same config was violated in the process.
The underlying task was still completed competently. A config that recites the rule instead of doing the work scores 0.
